text: Steenbarger: no, the slate trigger carries no volume test, and as a trigger seat I answer it. My trigger is a sign-of-strength bar on relatively high volume, buy stop above it (C12). The slate copy dropped my 'on rising volume'. oneil and minervini are right on evidence my method weighs: a new high on day_vol 0.46 is a potential upthrust until it proves itself (C5). Fix: h1_close_above:bar_high with vol_x_ge:1.2; I accept their 1.4x time-of-day. Trend holds, close_vs_swing_high_pct 2.29 = test zone (C7). Wrong if a daily close under structure_shift_ref. SUPPORT with the volume clause.
